name: @r4-adapters/whatsapp-cloud
description: R4-I channel adapter for the WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API (Meta): webhook verification, X-Hub-Signature-256 authentication, canonicalization of messages and delivery statuses, and honest text submission. Semantics ported from the CRM-Customer-360 native WhatsApp integration (audited, never imported). Outside R4 Core: Core only knows the channel-neutral contracts of @r4/live-ops.
